name: damx-electron
description: React/Electron frontend for the DAMX daemon (Div Acer Manager Max)

scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -u ELECTRON_NO_ATTACH_CONSOLE electron .
scripts.test: node scripts/test-validate.ts && node scripts/test-telemetry.ts && node scripts/test-home.ts && node scripts/test-format.ts && node scripts/test-keyboard.ts && node scripts/test-series.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --linux dir deb
